title: sutera cordata
intro: Sutera cordata, commonly known as the "candytuft", is a flowering plant belonging to the Phlox family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is said to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sutera cordata include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiseptic properties, making it a potential treatment for various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
